QuestInfo.name: To Mars
QuestInfo.0: Vieren wants to ask you more favor. Talk to him.
QuestInfo.1: Vieren asked you to do Mars a favor as well. Talk to #bMars#k in the lobby.

0.0: Could you perhaps do #bMars#k a favor as well? I know you guys don't really get along...\r\n#L0##bWhatever. Look, I haven't seen the White Mage in a while.#l\n#k
0.1: Yes, he's been all wrapped up in his work. Only #bMars#k is permitted to enter his lab these days. All the more reason to help...

yes.0: Good. You can go ask Mars what he needs. I suggest you guys become GOOD friends. He'll hook you up with all kinds of perks around here, I'm sure! \r\n#b(Talk to Mars in the lobby.)#k

no.0: Are you busy? Please come back when you have some time...

1.0: What is it? You want to help our research? Okay, as long as you don't touch anything.

yes.0: I really don't know what you're up to. I hope you're not thinking of touching anything...

npc.0: Go see #bMars#k. And no fighting, okay?
